name: Star Asia Investment Corp
summary: Star Asia Investment Corporation (SAR) began trading on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on April 20, 2016. The Star Asia Group acts as SAR's sponsor, bringing a substantial background in presenting real estate investment avenues, mainly within Japan, to institutional investors, primarily those based in the U.S. As an autonomous fund manager dedicated to "prioritizing investors' interests," the Star Asia Group consistently leverages its adaptable and varied investment methodologies to secure prime investment opportunities.
